environment_assessment.evidence: The Task 1C diagnostic recorded failed DNS resolution for both example.com and the configured proxy, with WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND 11001.
Workflow is limited to main-branch push/pull_request checks, contains no Yapo pilot job, and provides no configured proxy credential variables.
Read-only service metadata showed none of PROXY_URL, PROXY_URLS, YAPO_PROXY_URLS, PROXIES, PROXY_USER, or PROXY_PASS configured; the service is not an approved isolated scraper runner.

blocker: No available non-production test environment has verified DNS, permitted outbound access, and access to the contracted proxy configuration.
external_action_required: Restore DNS on an approved test runner or provide an already-authorized non-production runner with the contracted proxy configuration. If proxy-host DNS then fails while control DNS works, verify the exact contracted hostname, port, protocol, and account credentials in the provider dashboard; do not substitute values.
